name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A collapsible navigation sidebar with groups, icons and a mobile drawer.

css.content:
/* Radix tooltip content. The legacy .tip-wrap/.tip CSS-only tooltip still works. */
.tooltip { z-index: var(--z-toast); padding: var(--s1) var(--s3); background: var(--surface); color: var(--surface-text); font-size: var(--text-xs); max-width: 280px; animation: dialog-fade var(--fast) var(--ease); }

a11y: A navigation landmark named by the label prop, holding labelled lists of links; the current page has aria-current="page".
ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move focus between items; Tab still moves through them in order.
Collapsing keeps every label in the accessibility tree; a tooltip shows it on hover and keyboard focus. The toggle reports aria-expanded.
Below 800px the sidebar is hidden and the Menu button opens it in a left drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button. Choosing a link closes it.
In right-to-left layouts the sidebar sits on the right and the drawer opens from the right.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Whether the sidebar is collapsed to icons, when controlled. Pair with `onCollapsedChange`.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Whether the sidebar starts collapsed when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user collapses or expands the sidebar. Save it here (for example in localStorage) and pass it back as `defaultCollapsed` or `collapsed` to persist the choice.

props.name: children
props.description: Your layout: a `Sidebar`, plus any `SidebarToggle` or `SidebarTrigger` anywhere below.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark, in the sidebar and in the drawer. Default "Main".

props.name: drawerTitle
props.description: Names the drawer on small screens (its dialog title). Default "Menu".

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders each `SidebarItem` link, so a client router can handle the click. Default a plain `<a href>`. The returned element must forward its ref and spread extra props (collapsed tooltips need that).

props.name: children
props.description: A `SidebarHeader`, `SidebarContent` and `SidebarFooter`. They render twice: in the sidebar (from 800px) and in the drawer (below 800px).

props.name: label
props.description: A heading for the group. Hidden visually (a rule shows instead) when the sidebar is collapsed, still read by screen readers.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. Not needed with `asChild`.

props.name: icon
props.description: An inline SVG with `currentColor`; hidden from screen readers. Shown alone when the sidebar is collapsed.

props.name: current
props.description: The current page: sets `aria-current="page"` and the active style.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the child (your router's link) as the anchor. Its text becomes the label.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Visually hidden when collapsed and shown in a tooltip instead.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's accessible name. It reports expanded or collapsed through `aria-expanded`. Default "Toggle sidebar".

props.name: children
props.description: The button text, which is also its name. Default "Menu".

source.content:
export {Sidebar, SidebarProvider, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem, SidebarFooter, SidebarToggle, SidebarTrigger, useSidebar} from './sidebar';
export type {SidebarProps, SidebarProviderProps, SidebarGroupProps, SidebarItemProps, SidebarToggleProps, SidebarTriggerProps} from './sidebar';
